title: Phishing email received by victim
detail: Spoofed SBI email from 103.45.12.88 sent to victim. From: care@sbi-secure-alerts.in, Return-Path mismatch, SPF fail. Subject: 'Urgent: Your SBI account KYC verification required'.

title: Preliminary call from N1 to victim
detail: 9007198254 (N1) called 9876543210 (victim) for 312 seconds. Likely social engineering prior to main spoofed call.

title: Spoofed call from N1 to victim (key deception event)
detail: Spoofed inbound call from 9007198254 to victim 9876543210, 187 seconds. N1 IMEI-1 active on Cell CELL_MH_0041. Caller presented as SBI KYC officer.

title: N1 calls toll-free number (reconnaissance)
detail: 9007198254 called 1800110001 for 45 seconds — likely testing or verifying the SBI helpline number to use in the spoofing script.

title: SMS with APK link sent by N2 to victim
detail: SMS from 9999000002 (N2, same handset IMEI-1) containing link: http://sbi-kyc-verify.phishops.net/secure?ref=LX0918. Victim's Android dump confirms receipt.

evidenceRefs.excerpt: Click here to complete SBI KYC: http://sbi-kyc-verify.phishops.net...

title: Malicious APK installed by victim
detail: com.sbi.secureverify installed at 14:09:22 IST via browser (sideloaded). APK connects to 103.45.12.88. Permissions include READ_SMS, SEND_SMS, READ_CALL_LOG — enables OTP interception.

title: First fraudulent debit — ₹4,85,000 from victim to M1
detail: UPI debit of ₹4,85,000 from victim A/C XX4321 to M1 (9007198254@oksbi). UTR: UPI26918123456001. Case clock reference T+0.

title: M1 splits funds — ₹2,40,000 to M2
detail: M1 forwards ₹2,40,000 to M2 (ACC987654321) within 25 seconds of receipt. UTR: UPI26918123456002. Multi-hop routing signal triggered.

title: M1 splits funds — ₹2,45,000 to M3
detail: M1 forwards ₹2,45,000 to M3 (ACC112233445) within 38 seconds of receipt. UTR: UPI26918123456003. Balance in M1 drops to ₹0.

title: M2 forwards ₹2,35,000 to M4
detail: M2 forwards ₹2,35,000 to M4 (suspect@ybl). UPI settlement record shows reg_mobile 9007198254 on M4 — matches N2's MSISDN.

title: M3 ATM withdrawal — ₹1,00,000 (first)
detail: ATM withdrawal of ₹1,00,000 from M3 (ACC112233445) at Pune FC Road ATM. Ref: ATM26918100001. Balance drops to ₹1,45,000.

title: M3 ATM withdrawal ₹1,00,000 + M4 sends ₹2,30,000 to E1 exchange
detail: M3: second ATM withdrawal ₹1,00,000 (Ref: ATM26918100002), balance ~₹45,000. Simultaneously M4 transfers ₹2,30,000 to CryptoXchange (cryptoxchange@upi). Exchange deposit confirmed.

title: Victim lodges complaint — case clock
detail: Victim contacts SBI helpline and files cybercrime complaint. Case LX-2026-0918-A created. Case clock set to 15:09:00 IST. 37 minutes elapsed since first fraudulent debit.
